senses.gloss: m., מְכַבֶּדֶת f. (כָּבַד, Pi.) broom; also the fanshaped twig of the palm-tree.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Oktzin 1:3">Ukts. I, 3</cite> <he>יד המ׳ של תמרה</he> the stem of ‘the broom’ of the palm-tree; <cite ref="Tosefta Uktsin 1:4">Tosef. ib. I, 4</cite> <he>מכבדת</he>. Tanḥ. Masʿé 13 (ref. to <cite ref="K00030"><he>הכביד</he></cite>, <cite ref="Isaiah 8:23">Is. VIII, 23</cite>) <he>הכבידן כבמ׳</he> he swept them off as with a broom; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 23">Num. R. s. 23</cite>, end; Lam. R. introd. (R. Abbahu 2) <he>הממם כבמַכְבֵּיד</he>, v. <cite ref="E00622"><he>הָמַם</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 6:7">Tosef. Sabb. VI</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 7:7">VII</cite>), 7 <he>שב על המ׳</he> sit on a broom (a superstitious practice); a. e.—Pl. <he>מְכַבְּדוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Sukkah 13b:9">Succ. 13ᵇ</cite> <he>מ׳ ובהן תמרים</he> palm-twigs on which there are dates; Y. Bets. IV, 62ᶜ top.
<cite ref="Pesachim 56b:6">Pes. 56ᵇ</cite> <he>של מ׳</he> the dates hanging on the branches.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 4:1:3">Y. Peah IV, beg. 18ᵃ</cite> <he>תמרים במ׳</he> (leave for the poor) dates on the branches.
Y. Maasr. I, 48ᵈ bot.—[Sabb. 113ᵇ מְכֵבְּדוֹתַי, v. כָּבֵד I, Pi.]—[Ruth R. end מכבדות some ed., read: מַכְבֵּרוֹת.]
